title: More Healings and the Call of Matthew

questions.question: When some people brought a paralytic lying on a bed to Jesus, what did Jesus see that caused Him to say, "Take heart, my son; your sins are forgiven"?
options: Their faith
The man's tears
The crowd's persistence
The Pharisees' anger
questions.explanation: Matthew 9:2 (ESV): "And when Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralytic, 'Take heart, my son; your sins are forgiven.'"

questions.question: What did some of the scribes say to themselves when Jesus forgave the man's sins?
options: "This man is blaspheming."
"He is breaking the law of Moses."
"Only God can heal paralysis."
"He is truly a prophet."
questions.explanation: Matthew 9:3 (ESV): "And behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, 'This man is blaspheming.'"

questions.question: Why did Jesus tell the paralyzed man to rise, pick up his bed, and go home?
options: "That you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins"
To show the scribes he was just doing magic
Because the man needed his bed to sleep
So the large crowd could have space
questions.correctAnswer: "That you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins"
questions.explanation: Matthew 9:6 (ESV): "But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins—he then said to the paralytic—'Rise, pick up your bed and go home.'"

questions.question: What was Matthew doing when Jesus called him to follow?
options: Sitting at the tax booth
Fishing with his brothers
Teaching the law
Mending tents
questions.explanation: Matthew 9:9 (ESV): "As Jesus passed on from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax booth, and he said to him, 'Follow me.'"

questions.question: When the Pharisees asked why Jesus eats with tax collectors and sinners, what did He reply?
options: "Those who are well have no need of a physician, but those who are sick."
"They give the best tithes."
"The kingdom of God is for all people evenly."
"I eat with whom I please."
questions.correctAnswer: "Those who are well have no need of a physician, but those who are sick."
questions.explanation: Matthew 9:12 (ESV): "But when he heard it, he said, 'Those who are well have no need of a physician, but those who are sick.'"

questions.question: What scripture from Hosea did Jesus tell the Pharisees to go and learn?
options: "I desire mercy, and not sacrifice."
"The righteous shall live by faith."
"Love your neighbor as yourself."
"Obedience is better than sacrifice."
questions.explanation: Matthew 9:13 (ESV): "Go and learn what this means: 'I desire mercy, and not sacrifice.' For I came not to call the righteous, but sinners."

questions.question: When John's disciples asked why Jesus' disciples did not fast, what analogy did Jesus use?
options: "Can the wedding guests mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them?"
"Does a soldier fast before battle?"
"Is it right for a farmer to fast during harvest?"
"A king feasts in his own banquet hall."
questions.correctAnswer: "Can the wedding guests mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them?"
questions.explanation: Matthew 9:15 (ESV): "And Jesus said to them, 'Can the wedding guests mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them?'"

questions.question: Jesus said no one puts new wine into old wineskins because if they do, what will happen?
options: The skins burst, the wine is spilled, and the skins are destroyed
The wine loses its flavor
They are unable to open the skins later
The old skins absorb the new wine
questions.correctAnswer: The skins burst, the wine is spilled, and the skins are destroyed
questions.explanation: Matthew 9:17 (ESV): "Neither is new wine put into old wineskins. If it is, the skins burst and the wine is spilled and the skins are destroyed."

questions.question: A ruler (Jairus) came to Jesus and knelt before Him asking for what?
options: For Jesus to lay His hand on his newly dead daughter so she will live
For Jesus to cast out a legion of demons from his son
For his leprous wife to be cleansed
To forgive his debts to Rome
questions.correctAnswer: For Jesus to lay His hand on his newly dead daughter so she will live
questions.explanation: Matthew 9:18 (ESV): "...a ruler came in and knelt before him, saying, 'My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.'"

questions.question: On the way to the ruler's house, a woman who had suffered from a discharge of blood for twelve years came up behind Jesus and did what?
options: She touched the fringe of his garment
She kissed his feet
She shouted for mercy over the crowd
She threw a coin at his feet
questions.correctAnswer: She touched the fringe of his garment
questions.explanation: Matthew 9:20 (ESV): "And behold, a woman who had suffered from a discharge of blood for twelve years came up behind him and touched the fringe of his garment,"

questions.question: What did the woman with the discharge of blood say to herself?
options: "If I only touch his garment, I will be made well."
"He will not notice me in this crowd."
"Only the Son of David can heal me."
"I am unclean, but I must try."
questions.correctAnswer: "If I only touch his garment, I will be made well."
questions.explanation: Matthew 9:21 (ESV): "for she said to herself, 'If I only touch his garment, I will be made well.'"

questions.question: When Jesus arrived at the ruler's house, what did He say to the flute players and the noisy crowd?
options: "Go away, for the girl is not dead but sleeping."
"Silence in the presence of the Lord."
"Let her rest in peace."
"Why do you weep without faith?"
questions.correctAnswer: "Go away, for the girl is not dead but sleeping."
questions.explanation: Matthew 9:24 (ESV): "he said, 'Go away, for the girl is not dead but sleeping.' And they laughed at him."

questions.question: After raising the girl, two blind men followed Jesus crying out. By what title did they call Him?
options: Son of David
King of the Jews
Son of God
Holy One of Israel
questions.explanation: Matthew 9:27 (ESV): "two blind men followed him, crying aloud, 'Have mercy on us, Son of David.'"

questions.question: Before Jesus healed the blind men in the house, what question did He ask them?
options: "Do you believe that I am able to do this?"
"Have you repented of your sins?"
"Why have you followed me here?"
"Who do you say that I am?"
questions.correctAnswer: "Do you believe that I am able to do this?"
questions.explanation: Matthew 9:28 (ESV): "...And Jesus said to them, 'Do you believe that I am able to do this?' They said to him, 'Yes, Lord.'"

questions.question: Seeing the crowds, Jesus had compassion for them, because they were harassed and helpless, like what?
options: Like sheep without a shepherd
Like a boat tossed in a storm
Like orphans abandoned in the streets
Like chicks without a hen
questions.explanation: Matthew 9:36 (ESV): "When he saw the crowds, he had compassion for them, because they were harassed and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd."

key_verse_text: "Go and learn what this means: 'I desire mercy, and not sacrifice.' For I came not to call the righteous, but sinners."
